app.lightcoursewordinstructions: Export this course, edit inside the green field boxes in Word, then import it into this same course. Grey labels, section headings and the course details and settings at the top are read-only. Article and block sections are omitted from Word but stay unchanged in the course. Choose a minor (part) or major (full) version on import: a new saved version is created and becomes the editable draft. Previous saved versions stay unchanged. Keep the boxes and course sections intact; you can add paragraphs or clear a box, but cannot add, remove or reorder course elements. Tracked changes are accepted automatically on import. Rich-text boxes preserve paragraphs, line breaks, headings, bold, italics, underline, strikethrough, lists, alignment and links. Plain text fields such as titles and unique IDs remain plain text. Unchanged HTML is retained exactly. Embedded media and tables must be edited in the course editor instead; Word fonts, sizes and colours are not imported. Older exports remain supported but import edited text as plain paragraphs. Settings, assets and component defaults are not changed.
